text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: (—Reach them.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: (Reach them... —Reach them!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Love your destiny! And enjoy it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Can you hear me?! My destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If your heart is moved, then you can hear 
this voice! And what moved it—was my 
running!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Soaring toward greater heights alongside 
destiny— you bore witness to my run!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
How is it, isn't it magnificent?! You run 
too—love your destiny, and go far beyond!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: That voice just now was...?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ............It's burning—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia has done it!! She believed in 
herself and ran through to the end!! The 
title of the strongest and her dream are 
all hers nowwwwww!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —Epi-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...As I have mentioned before. I, too, 
will definitely... win the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill a destiny befitting a noble 
house. ............And besides.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to reach it. —The heights 
where you stand."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Do you see that, Trainer! Eff's eyes are 
glowing the exact same color as mine...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Epi-senpai is so cool...!" "—Could this 
be destiny...?" "I think I just heard 
Epi-san's voice...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The voices of admiration for Epiphaneia 
continue to spread—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No, not everyone.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer, listen closely. ...There.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san...! That was so cool!" 
"Shion-chan! I love you!" "I'm gonna be 
just like Meno-san!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just voices calling out for me. 
Everyone has their own destiny they feel—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...I see. It's not just my destiny alone.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Space is so, so much vaster... —I can't 
illuminate everything.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't the sun after all. I can't become 
the destiny for every Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ――But so what?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll become a comet!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I'll fly right into everyone's hearts and 
give them as much of a push as my hands 
can manage!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, in the far future— my voice 
will explode outwards and spread across 
the world."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Until the day the world is filled with 
destiny— let us march forward together, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll see it through to the end!
Yeah, I'll see it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the path she blazes from here on 
out, a brilliant sight surely awaits—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Because Epiphaneia is beloved by fate.
